description: This file defines the MenuContextCardInjector class, which manages injecting a custom SwiftUI view into an NSMenu in macOS. It handles cache loading, menu item insertion, menu delegate forwarding, and background cache refreshing to display session-related data within the menu context.

classes.name: MenuContextCardInjector
classes.description: A singleton class that injects custom views into macOS status item menus, managing cache data and menu delegation.

methods.name: install
methods.description: Attaches the injector to a status item and initializes cache warming.

methods.name: menuWillOpen
methods.description: Handles menu opening; injects a custom SwiftUI card view and initiates cache refresh.

methods.name: menuDidClose
methods.description: Handles cleanup when the menu closes.

methods.name: menuNeedsUpdate
methods.description: Forwards menu update requests to the original delegate.

methods.name: confinementRect
methods.description: Determines the confinement rectangle for the menu, potentially constrained by the original delegate.

methods.name: refreshCache
methods.description: Asynchronously loads or updates cached session rows, handling errors and timing.

methods.name: cachedView
methods.description: Returns a SwiftUI view displaying the current cached session rows or status.

methods.name: loadCurrentRows
methods.description: Asynchronously loads current session rows, filtering by activity window and sorting.

methods.name: findInsertIndex
methods.description: Determines the proper index to insert the custom menu item, typically before specific separators.

methods.name: initialCardWidth
methods.description: Calculates an initial width for the injected card, based on menu state.

methods.name: captureMenuWidthIfAvailable
methods.description: Captures menu width from the hosting view or window for size consistency.
